# Javier Castro

Hi! I am PhD student in Mathematics at TU Berlin. My supervisor is Prof. Benjamin Gess.

My research lies at the interface between scientific machine learning,
numerical analysis of PDEs, stochastic analysis, and optimization.

[Download my CV](cv.pdf){.btn .btn-primary}

## Research interests

- Scientific machine learning for nonlinear PDEs
- Weak-residual and thermodynamically informed neural methods
- Numerical approximation of PDEs and SDEs
- Gauss–Newton and natural-gradient methods
- Stochastic gradient dynamics and weak approximation
